settings.headline: Hydration that carries its own energy.
settings.body: Sodium, potassium, magnesium, and calcium citrate replace the minerals you lose through sweat. A full B-complex, including methylated B12 and P5P vitamin B6, supports the way your body turns food into usable energy. No caffeine, so it hydrates without borrowing against your evening.
settings.disclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

settings.question: How is this different from your Creatine Hydration Powder?
settings.answer: There is no creatine in this one. It is electrolytes and B vitamins, built for daily hydration rather than training performance. If you want creatine and electrolytes together in a single scoop, Creatine Hydration Powder is the one you want. Plenty of people keep both and use this on the days they are not training.

settings.question: When should I drink it?
settings.answer: Whenever you need it. Morning, mid-afternoon, during a workout, or after a long flight. There is no caffeine in it, so having it late will not keep you up.

settings.question: How much water do I mix it with?
settings.answer: One scoop into 14 to 20 ounces of water, adjusted to taste. Two scoops go into 28 to 40 ounces. Keep it under five scoops in any 24 hour period.

settings.question: Is it really sugar-free?
settings.answer: Yes, there is no sugar in it. The sweetness comes from sucralose and the taste from a natural and artificial lemonade flavor blend, which is what keeps it keto-friendly and light. The full ingredient list is on this page, and we would rather you read it than take our word for it.

settings.question: Can I take it alongside your other supplements?
settings.answer: Yes. It sits well with Premium Creatine, Colostrum, and Collagen. It does contain magnesium, so if you also take Magnesium Glycinate at night, keep an eye on your total for the day.

settings.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Yes, anytime. No fees, no penalties, no runaround. Log into your account and cancel before your next billing date. If you have trouble, email us and we will handle it the same day.
